purpose: Interface contract between Benji's off-chain strategy controller (the policy brain) and Bob's on-chain keeper (the execution hands) for the active single-sided LP buyback system on Base. Controller emits INTENTS; keeper executes on Uni V3 / Aerodrome Slipstream and emits FILL_REPORTs + position STATE. Venue-neutral: clean price bounds in, keeper rounds to the pool's tick spacing.

rung_types.buy: single-sided USDC position placed BELOW spot; converts USDC→token as price falls. Sized so P_bot=(Q/T)^2/P_top. Fills = accumulated tokens.
rung_types.sell: single-sided TOKEN position placed ABOVE spot; converts token→USDC as price rises. Mirror of buy. Fills = realized USDC.

intent.action: "open" | "close" | "roll"  (roll = close ref_position_id then open the new rung atomically if possible)
intent.P_top: number · upper price bound, USDC/token (clean; keeper snaps to tick)

amount.value: number · capital to deploy (USDC for buy rung, tokens for sell rung)

intent.ref_position_id: string · optional; required for close/roll — the tokenId to act on

fill_report.position_id: string · NFT tokenId of the CL position
fill_report.fill_pct: 0-100 · how much of the range has converted (for 'converting')

position_state._dir: keeper → controller · periodic or event-driven, powers roll decisions + monitoring UI

rung_lifecycle: PLANNED   — controller decided a rung; intent emitted
OPEN      — keeper minted; single-sided, price outside band on the funded side
CONVERTING— spot inside [P_bot,P_top]; partial conversion underway (0<fill_pct<100)
FILLED    — spot crossed the far bound; 100% converted to the other asset
then controller picks one: ROLLED (open mirror rung across spot) | HELD (keep as inventory) | CLOSED (withdraw)
CANCELLED — controller closed an OPEN/CONVERTING rung early (e.g. re-range on spot drift)
FAILED    — tx/keeper error; controller retries or alerts
notes: Idempotency: keeper must dedupe on intent_id (retries are safe).
The controller never signs or holds keys — it only emits intents; Bob's keeper owns the wallet/signer on the VPS.
Accounting: controller reconstructs inventory + PnL purely from fill_reports (usdc/token in-out + fees + gas). No trust in off-chain state.
Awaiting venue pick (Slipstream vs Uni V3) to bind tick_spacing; bounds stay venue-neutral until then.
